Theme Songs v0.1.6 for Silo, Linux amd64 and arm64.

The README now walks through updating an installed plugin in Administration → Plugins → Installed, editing Provider settings (JSON), preserving existing values, saving the configuration and running Preview.

The guide includes Silo's bundled FFmpeg and ffprobe paths and examples showing how the provider-only form field differs from a complete settings object. Configure FFmpeg inside Provider settings (JSON) and ffprobe in its dedicated field.

New theme downloads continue to use the MP3 conversion introduced in v0.1.5. Install through the Crowquillx plugin catalog or upload the matching raw binary. Release downloads and tarballs include the updated README. Verify downloads with `checksums.txt`.
